# Multi-Model Shot Prompts

Rewrite one ecommerce shot list / storyboard into video-generation prompts tailored to different video models: a universal skeleton with a product lock (PRODUCT LOCK), a nine-term camera-movement vocabulary, adaptation rules for text-to-video, first-frame image-to-video and first-and-last-frames input, a Chinese and an English version per shot plus a negative line where the model supports it and a local fallback motion, and a template for batch-rewriting a whole shot list — model-neutral, with no invented model price or parameter, for Seedance, Kling, Veo, Runway, Hailuo, Wan, Sora, Pika or any other video model.
